title: Jimmy's Journey
description:
Hi, I'm Jimmy. It's been a while!
Come and have another look around campus with me. We'll start at the square, then stop by the library, cafe and dormitory. There are things to find and a few puzzles to work out. Hang on to the tools you pick up. We'll need them for the vines, the dusty windows and that broken fountain.

Some things are tucked away, so zoom in and have a closer look. Read the notes and diary pages too. They might save you a bit of guesswork. To use a tool, select it from your pocket and click where you think it belongs. Wrong tool? Pick another and try again.

There are 10 areas to explore, with files to sort, circuits to reconnect and valves to adjust along the way. Take them at your own pace. There's no timer, and a wrong click won't cost you anything. Tap the lightbulb if you get stuck. You can also keep playing after the main story to find the photos and other bits you missed.

Progress saves automatically. The new version supports Steam Cloud and 24 achievements. Settings let you switch to evening lighting, reduce motion and choose a language. You can play in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German or French.Looking for the original game?In your Steam Library, right-click the game > Properties > Betas > select legacy. Let the download finish, then launch as usual. Select None in the same menu to return to the new version.

The two versions keep separate saves. The update won't overwrite your original save, but you can't use that save to continue in the new chapter.
description_short: Come back to campus with Jimmy. Look for hidden objects, read a few notes and work out what needs fixing. Take your time. There's no timer or penalty for a wrong click.
